{{Quote|Tell you what, Human. You get us that kilo of spice we were talking about... and we'll make sure you get your beast.|Quarren cantina patron|<ref name="Shadows and Light">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref>}}
An '''[[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] cantina patron''' and his [[Unidentified Quarren cantina patron|Quarren]] friend were approached in the cantina in [[Dreshdae]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in [[3993 BBY]] by [[Duron Qel-Droma]] and [[Shaela Nuur]], who were on Korriban on a [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|mission]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], looking for a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]]. The Ithorian and Quarren agreed to provide the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with information that could help them on their quest. Their payment was [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] inquivalent to one kilo of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].
